object: Issa Rae and Awkward Black Girl
belief: Issa Rae created the web series "Awkward Black Girl" (also known as "The Mis-Adventures of Awkward Black Girl"), which premiered on YouTube in 2011.

author: worker_2
belief: Issa Rae has achieved significant professional success: she co-created, co-wrote, and starred in HBO's Insecure (2016-2021), received multiple Golden Globe and Emmy nominations, her memoir became a New York Times bestseller, she was included in Time 100 and Forbes 30 Under 30, and won a Peabody Trailblazer Award and PGA Visionary Award.
